Cost: 2 Investiture

You don’t just survive. You adapt.

Spend 2 Investiture and touch a willing creature. Choose one biological adaptation: Bone Spurs (melee attacks deal additional Keen damage equal to Tier), Venom Glands (melee hits inflict Afflicted [half [Tier][Die] Vital]), or Dense Tissue (+2 Deflect and immune to forced movement). One mutation per creature; scene duration.

MutatePick000000.description: Life (Anaveth). 2bW — the chooser as a rule (was the name-keyed useItem case): a whispered card offers the three adaptations for your willing target (default you); the click bakes the pick onto the creature's `mutation` flag for the scene, one per creature. The flag readers were always name-free: Bone Spurs rides the outgoing damage pre-pass (melee-gated), Venom Glands the on-hit post-pass (edhaAddAffliction), Dense Tissue the incoming deflect reduce + the forced-movement veto (Ben E16). An apex grant doubles all of them (Ben E19).

description.value:
Activation: 3

Cost: 3 Investiture

You are the vessel. The river flows through you now.

Spend 3 Investiture and touch a willing creature (may be self). For the scene: the target regenerates [Tier][Die] HP at the start of each of its turns, gains +2 Deflect, and deals additional Vital damage equal to your Tier on all attacks. Active mutations on the target are doubled in effect. When the effect ends, the target takes an Injury. Once per scene.

ApexGrant0000000.description: Life (Anaveth). 2bW — the capstone's FIVE mechanics on one rule (was the name-keyed useItem case; LESSONS §2's count-the-mechanics check done): (1) start-of-ITS-turn [Tier][Die on Green] regeneration via the lifeRegen queue; (2) +2 Deflect and (3) +tier vital on its attacks via the `apexForm` flag; (4) active adaptations DOUBLED — every mutation reader checks the same flag (Ben E19); (5) the Injury when it ends — the scene reset's apex branch reads the flag's sourceName (auto at scene end). Willing target, default you.

VNI8dX39VPHLxF7y.description: Life (Anaveth). Heal overflow becomes Temp HP (auto). The +1 Deflect (stacks to 3) is ENFORCED (07-12) and — 07-25 pass 2bS — selected by deflectStackMax on THIS rule, not the talent's name: each heal by this talent steps a +1/+2/+3 Deflect AE on the healed creature (system.deflect.bonus); clears when combat ends. Life Surge carries the identical overflow rule with no deflectStackMax and grants no Deflect. NOTE: the heroic Edgedancer/Truthwatcher 'Overgrowth' talents share this name and also receive this rule - harmless, they never heal.
